itens.titulo: Intel Stock Tumbles Ahead of Q3 Earnings
itens.descricao: Intel Stock Tumbles Ahead of Q3 Earnings Yahoo Finance
trechos: Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) fell about 5% in Thursday morning trading as investors assessed whether the chipmaker can turn heavy manufacturing investment and tight supply into stronger results ahead of its Oct.
Analysts forecast adjusted earnings of 39 cents per share on revenue of $16.45 billion, compared with 42 cents and $16.13 billion in the prior quarter.
GuruFocus has detected 4 Warning Signs with INTC.
Intel's third-quarter outlook calls for revenue of $15.8 billion to $16.8 billion, adjusted earnings of 38 cents per share and a 42% gross margin at the midpoint.
At Intel Foundry, 18A output ran 25% above target and external foundry revenue totaled $293 million.
Its next 14A process is targeted for risk production in the second half of 2027.
Susquehanna cut its price target to $105 on Oct.
21, while TD Cowen lowered its target to $95 on Oct.
